title: Malmgren introduced to Putin at an arranged meeting

tellings.quote: Be looked for me, found me in the crowd, brought me over, and he introduced me to Putin.

tellings.difference: Names Primakov as the person who introduced him and places the meeting in St. Petersburg in 1992, with Primakov saying Putin was rising.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Malmgren's own account of being found in a crowd and introduced to Putin.

plain: Harold Malmgren, a former presidential advisor, says the Russian official Yevgeny Primakov once picked him out of a crowd, brought him over and introduced him to Vladimir Putin, saying: "This man is rising. He will soon be very important to Russia. You should know him." Malmgren tells it as something he lived through, and in one version he places the meeting in St. Petersburg in 1992, when Putin was not yet widely known.
